hunks.baseline: At Hwangso’s sullen reply, his Senior Brother’s face stiffened.
hunks.sol: His Senior Brother’s face stiffened at Hwangso’s sullen reply.

hunks.sol: “Watch your words. Not since the Great Faction War has the Sichuan Murim united to cast a net over heaven and earth like this. Everything happens for a reason.”

hunks.baseline: Hwangso had heard the reason for the net over heaven and earth so many times that his ears were practically bleeding.
hunks.sol: Hwangso had heard why the net over heaven and earth had been cast so many times that his ears hurt.

hunks.baseline: Dark Heaven or whatever they were called had invaded and turned the Tang Clan, Qingcheng, and Emei into ruins.
hunks.sol: Dark Heaven or whatever they were called had invaded and laid waste to the Tang Clan, Qingcheng, and Emei.

hunks.baseline: “……Whew.”
hunks.sol: “…Whew.”

hunks.baseline: His Senior Brother moved his lips as if he were about to say something, then answered with a sigh instead.
hunks.sol: His Senior Brother’s lips moved as if he were about to reply, but he merely sighed.

hunks.sol: *The unknown master who suddenly appeared and saved Qingcheng Sect. The countless Beggars’ Sect disciples and members of nearby martial sects who rushed to Emei’s aid. And…*

hunks.sol: If not for *them*, the ones who had saved the Sichuan Tang Clan from annihilation, three illustrious sects with centuries of history would have vanished from the Murim five days ago.

hunks.sol: The Three-Gate Bloodbath had been a large-scale assault conducted with such ruthless precision and suddenness that it had shaken the entire orthodox martial world.

hunks.baseline: *But for a martial artist’s thoughts to be this shallow… Even if he only joined because circumstances forced him to…*
hunks.sol: *And this brat calls himself a martial artist with such shallow thinking. Even if he did join only because circumstances forced him to…*

hunks.baseline: At the sight of his Senior Brother shaking his head, Hwangso bristled.
hunks.sol: Hwangso bristled when his Senior Brother shook his head.

hunks.sol: “Enough. Pick ten men or so and search beyond that hill.”

hunks.sol: “The area assigned to our sect must be searched a hundred times—a thousand, if necessary. I’ll search the nearby undergrowth myself, so stop complaining and do as you’re told.”

hunks.baseline: His Senior Brother cut him off decisively. Hwangso clamped his mouth shut.

hunks.baseline: *I’ll have to talk to Father and get back home as soon as possible. No, seriously, why would the fiend who fled Emei show up here?*
hunks.sol: *I need to talk to Father and get back home as soon as possible. Seriously, why would the fiend who fled Emei show up here?*

hunks.baseline: The net over heaven and earth, in which thousands of people had been deployed, had lived up to its name.
hunks.sol: Thousands of people had been mobilized for the net over heaven and earth, and it had lived up to its name.

hunks.sol: Only the Third Fiend—the youngest of the Qilian Three Fiends who had attacked Emei—remained. The area assigned to the Gongdao Sect lay near Chengdu, practically the heart of Sichuan.

hunks.sol: It might be darkest beneath the lamp, but there was still no reason for a fiend branded an enemy of the Murim to break through such a dense net over heaven and earth and head toward Chengdu.

hunks.sol: *If there were even the slightest chance of that, why would I be here? The Qingcheng Daoists would be guarding this place.*

hunks.baseline: This was all because his Senior Brother was so rigid that he was practically suffocating.
hunks.sol: This was all because his Senior Brother was so rigid that it went beyond stubbornness and became downright suffocating.

hunks.baseline: Muttering a quiet curse under his breath, Hwangso crooked a finger at the third-generation disciples standing around blankly.
hunks.sol: Muttering a quiet curse, Hwangso crooked a finger at the third-generation disciples standing around blankly.

hunks.sol: “You there, the big-nosed one. Yes, you. Everyone from you to that big-eared fellow over there. Ten of you—follow me.”

hunks.sol: What else could he do? Orders were orders.

hunks.sol: The Third Fiend let out a sigh of relief and pushed off.
